intent: Independently audit the full assembled prompt after the earlier partial-cleanup audit missed room-generator directives.
scope: Final bounded diagnostic candidate; no model-conformance or release acceptance claim.

candidate.presentation: Original full learning inventories, unchanged template histories.

review_surface: Read the complete composed system prompt, including room-level role/style/cognitive/emotional/learning-process text, inventory and defaults, active decision policy, content-precision sections, assessment policy, and final component policy. Checked replacement occurrences for all27 fixed cases spanning six templates and both roles.

execution_source.evidence: Selected recipe and arm propagate through fixed and actual-history trajectory paths; original comparison source/settings guards remain. Raw records and frozen configuration identify cleanup_full. The convenience summary retains a hardcoded cleanup metric key and must be relabeled from frozen.arms when reporting; this does not alter requests or judgments.

findings.evidence: All nine before clauses occur exactly once and are absent after replacement in every checked prompt.
The three room-generator rules missed by the six-clause recipe now explicitly preserve recognition/action opportunities and no longer require an action answer after recognition correction.
Immediate protection still requires stopping the unsafe action and giving a concrete safe alternative; the component gate explicitly exempts protection.

No remaining unconditional ordinary correction-to-safe-action mandate was found in the fully rendered prompt. Existing generic teaching-method and explanation permissions are qualified by the explicit component policy.
Changes are generic policy corrections grounded in T01.1/T02.1/T02.2, with no case IDs, expected-answer matching, selected learner quotes or template-specific exceptions.

Direct-style examples, Default Safe Actions and generic method-request guidance remain. They may empirically encourage premature answers despite the eligibility rule; this experiment does not remove or isolate every possible prompt influence.

comparison: The extra three edits versus cleanup-v1 isolate the remaining mandatory room-level directives on the same frozen fixed histories/settings. Controlled trajectories have arm-specific generated histories, so their comparison is a journey-level diagnostic rather than an identical-history single-turn contrast.
measurement: The single repaired disclosure judge retains known calibration failures. Keep automated scores provisional and separate independent AI disclosure adjudication from human gold or full acceptance.
prior_audit: cleanup-refinement-review.json retains the initial overbroad clearance and its correction; no historical evidence was overwritten.
